in_marathi.name: Iraja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler, King, Queen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iraja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Iraja comes from the Sanskrit word ‘Iraj’ meaning ruler or king. This name is used for both boys and girls and holds a significant place in Hindu mythology where Iraja is a title given to various deities and spiritual figures. The name symbolizes power, authority, and rule, and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
